title: Give finding-registry capability targets qualified engine ownership
description:
Decomposed out of eshyra-o9bd.19.1.6 (PR #476) 2026-07-26 under the churn stop
rule. Review of f75acb2 found this as a NEW DEFECT CLASS.

DEFECT: a target may be LABELLED target.kind='capability', but the identity
union can only express a record, clause, path or artifact. There is no
engine:F1..F10 family, no primitive, no hook, and no qualified capability owner.
So a capability target names something other than a capability.

CONSEQUENCE: engine findings cannot be joined to the capability ledger
(eshyra-o9bd.19.5.1) or to the engine:F* family epics under eshyra-olc5. The
cross-surface link the audit program depends on does not exist.

SCOPE: extend the identity union so a capability target names a qualified
engine:F1..engine:F10 identity, its primitive, the relevant hook where one
exists, and its owning bead — and validate all of it. Align with the capability
identity shape the bootstrap ledger uses so the two are mechanically joinable.

DEPENDENCY: coordinate with eshyra-o9bd.19.5.1, which owns the ledger-side
identity. Do not invent a third shape.
acceptance_criteria:
• A capability target names a qualified engine:F1..F10 identity, primitive, hook where applicable, and owning bead, all validated.
• The identity shape is mechanically joinable with the bootstrap capability ledger.
• Engine findings resolve to their family epic under eshyra-olc5.
• No third competing capability identity shape is introduced.
close_reason: Implemented in c73f6bc on PR #476 branch; supervisor-verified 4726 passed, 19 skipped.
